evidence: Checked every graded demand (6 gate/polish, 40 functional, 3 visual criteria) against the brief for reachability and a second reading. Runtime is reachable: environment/Dockerfile supplies Node 22, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 via NODE_PATH as integration.md:5 states; tests/test.sh launches node /app/server.js with PORT=3000, DB_PATH and a writable copy fallback, matching integration.md:3,9; seed_data.json has no snippets, matching integration.md:7 and instruction.md:3; network_mode=public lets the agent fetch parser/formatter libraries that policy.md:3 and ui.md:3 allow. The hard capabilities are achievable in-browser, and the golden demonstrates each by source: preview fetch denial to both loopback names via a preview CSP connect-src 'none' (runtime.ts:7, security.md:3 now names exactly localhost and 127.0.0.1, matching cw_preview_isolation and app_context 'No criterion needs any address outside this machine'); the endless-loop/5 s budget via loop-guard instrumentation plus a cross-origin runner and a 5.1 s watchdog (runtime.ts:33-63,371-389); last-good picture with form and canvas state (snapshot messages); stale save and old-page restore via 409 revision checks and a restore that remembers base revision (server.js:54-57,95-104); live library and newer-revision notice by polling (app.tsx:138-154). The previously implicit items are now public: Ctrl/Cmd+A select-all (ui.md:5, used by cw_newer_run_supersedes), backwards Find wrap (ui.md:11, cw_find_forward_backward_wrap), Ctrl+Home/End (ui.md:5), Redo by usual shortcut (criterion tries Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z), the HTTP-visible restore that a replay must not duplicate (behaviour.md:13, with the criterion accepting a refused replay), and 390 px width (ui.md:17). Second-reading probes: 'last run that worked' could be read as 'synchronous part did not throw', but behaviour.md:5 says a stopped run puts 'that picture back' and defines settling, so a stopped run cannot become last-good; single-caret Undo granularity is explicitly free and cw_undo_restores_caret passes under either grouping; triple-click line with or without break, quote-style change in Format, and choice of modifier in multi-caret delete/same-line criteria are all tolerated by the criteria. JS error line 'counted from one' (behaviour.md:3) has only one sensible base (the draft's first line). No ambiguity or unreachable item found that would fail a conforming build. Looser for the model since v15: security.md:3 narrowed the preview boundary from 'any outside address or this app's own routes' to the playground's own address under its two loopback names, so a preview that can reach the public internet now conforms (consistent across brief, app_context and cw_preview_isolation; scope reduction, not ambiguity); prose moved from 'must' to requester 'should', which still reads as a request. Nothing else got looser. Limits: no raw-evidence-index exists for this round, so no golden or verifier run was measured here; this row's verdict rests on the brief/criteria/source reading. Internal annotation says 'with no network'; the delivery profile's public network governs and is consistent with the task.
